summary: This stage executed a disciplined partial replication of Paper P after creating an isolated virtual environment and downloading MUSE vectors. It successfully reproduced the Table 1 Spanish original MWEAT (3.6918), Spanish Shift Ori difference (0.3087 vs 0.3090), direction cosine (0.3885 vs 0.389), Figure 4 Spearman correlation (0.450), and MUSE P@1/P@5 translation baselines within 0.4 percentage points. It correctly identified that SemEval-2017 Task 2 lacks French data (blocking French word similarity) and that 13 unreleased matrices block the mitigated methods. However, it missed the deeper validity flaws, including the meaningless permutation p-values and the masculine-cue bias in the word-pair translation task.
